verdict.rationale: Evidence shows scheduling support only for broadcast sends ('Schedule email to be sent later... natural language or ISO 8601', resend-docs-13, resend-docs-35), not explicitly for the core transactional send-email API, and there is no evidence anywhere in the pack of a cancel-before-send endpoint or capability. Missing for 10: documented scheduled_at support on the transactional /emails endpoint, an explicit cancel-scheduled-email API/endpoint, and any hands-on confirmation that cancellation works.
